### Active Members {#active-members}

**`r kpi_weekly |> filter(week == max(week)) |> pull(active_90d_count)`** out of **`r kpi_weekly |> filter(week == max(week)) |> pull(total_user_count)`** users were active, which is **`r kpi_weekly |> filter(week == max(week)) |> pull(prop_active_90d) * 100 |> round(1)`%** of the community. The target for this indicator is set as **≥ 30%**.

The proportion of active members reflects users who logged in **at least once within the past 90 days**, based on weekly snapshots. Members who have not logged in during that 90-day window are considered inactive (dormant or uninterested).

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false

# Filter to last 3 months (~12 weeks)
active_kpi_plot <- kpi_weekly %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - 84)

# Plot
ggplot(active_kpi_plot, aes(x = week, y = prop_active_90d)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00205C", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#00205C", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Active Members",
    subtitle = glue("As of {format(max(active_kpi_plot$week), '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = expansion(add = c(7, 7))  # extend left/right
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

```

### Posting Activity {#posting-act}

**`r monthly_posters_kpi |> filter(week == max(week)) |> pull(prop_active_posters) * 100 |> round(1)`%** of members posted at least once in the most recent month.

Posting activity tracks sustained member interaction with the platform by measuring the proportion of users who post at least once per month through Collaboratory channels.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
# Filter to last 3 months (~12 weeks)
posting_kpi_plot <- monthly_posters_kpi %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - 84)

# Plot
ggplot(posting_kpi_plot, aes(x = week, y = prop_active_posters)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00205C", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#00205C", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Posting Activity",
    subtitle = glue("As of {format(max(posting_kpi_plot$week), '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = expansion(add = c(7, 7))  # extend left/right padding
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
  limits = c(
    floor(min(posting_kpi_plot$prop_active_posters) * 1000) / 1000,
    ceiling(max(posting_kpi_plot$prop_active_posters) * 1000) / 1000
  ),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))
) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

### Engagement {#engagement}

Monthly engagement metrics provide an overview of user activity on the forum. These include total and new user counts, along with averages for user activity.Users are classified by recency of activity:

-   **Active**: last seen within 90 days
-   **Dormant**: last seen 91–180 days ago
-   **Uninterested**: last seen more than 180 days ago

Engagement intensity is assessed based on the average time a user spends reading per month, normalized by account age, enabling comparison across all users. Based on this measure, users are categorized as:

-   **Highly Engaged**: 15 or more minutes per month
-   **Moderately Engaged**: between 2 and 15 minutes per month
-   **Barely Engaged**: less than 2 minutes per month

::: panel-tabset
#### Engagement Metrics {#engagement-metrics}

All figures reflect month-over-month changes to support interpretation of longer-term trends. Note that the monthly change for activity and engagement reflects increases or decreases in absolute numbers, and does not indicate changes in their proportional share of the user base.

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
metrics_table %>%
  kbl(format = "html", align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
, escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 15
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "16em", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "12em") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "12em") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "12em", 
              color = dplyr::case_when(
                grepl("-", metrics_table$`Monthly Change`) ~ "black",
                grepl("\\d", metrics_table$`Monthly Change`) ~ "black",
                TRUE ~ "black"
              )
  )%>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, color = "white", background = "#009ADE")
```

### Engagement Levels {#eng-levels}

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
# Step 1: Convert wide to long, calculate ratios per week
engagement_long <- engagement_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Category,
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "Users"
  ) %>%
  mutate(week = as.Date(week)) %>%
  group_by(week) %>%
  mutate(
    total_users = sum(Users, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio = Users / total_users
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Filter last 3 months (~84 days) of data
engagement_recent <- engagement_long %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - 84)

# Step 3: Clean category names and set factor levels
engagement_recent <- engagement_recent %>%
  mutate(
    Category = recode(Category,
      "Barely engaged (under 2 min/month)" = "Barely engaged",
      "Moderately engaged (2-15 min/month)" = "Moderately engaged",
      "Highly engaged (15+ min/month)" = "Highly engaged"
    ),
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
      "Barely engaged", "Moderately engaged", "Highly engaged"
    ))
  )



```

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 2
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| out.width: 100%

# Step 5: Horizontal stacked bar chart for latest week
latest_week <- max(engagement_recent$week)
engagement_latest <- engagement_recent %>%
  filter(week == latest_week) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_percent = ratio * 100,
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Highly engaged", "Moderately engaged", "Barely engaged"))
  )

bar_chart <- ggplot(engagement_latest, aes(x = 1, y = prop_percent, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_percent, 1), "%")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Barely engaged" = "#00205C",
      "Moderately engaged" = "#009ADE",
      "Highly engaged" = "#F4A81D"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Engagement Levels – Latest Week",
    subtitle = glue("As of {format(report_date, '%d %B %Y')}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, family = "Lato", color = "#2F3E46", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, family = "Lato", face = "italic", color = "#2F3E46"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, family = "Lato", face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9, family = "Lato"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 20, 10, 20)
  )

bar_chart
```

### Collaborative Resources and Repositories

Members share resources and tools through Collaboratory, highlighting collaboration and the exchange of knowledge within the community.

##### Repository and Resource Metrics

-   Total repositories (all types): 24
-   Repositories linked to communities: 20
-   Number of communities with at least one repository: 8
-   Total uploads (tools and resources): 385

##### Repository Engagement

-   Number of collaborators: 34
-   Number of watchers: 72

Note: Counts may include overlaps across repositories.
